title: DOE EM infrastructure: Idaho's aged-asset and maintenance denominator
publisher: U.S. Government Accountability Office and named U.S. agencies
summary: GAO reports that Idaho had 409 facilities, 121 mission-critical facilities, and 213 assets more than 30 years old as of June 2025. Nine mission-critical facilities had poor or very poor condition indexes and five were rated inadequate; repair needs were $248.4 million and deferred maintenance was $52.1 million. Denominator: Idaho Cleanup Project facilities and operating-or-standby maintenance measures as of June 2025.
